questions.question: The London Congestion Charge applies on:
questions.explanation: The Congestion Charge currently runs Mon–Fri 7:00–18:00 and weekends 12:00–18:00, except certain Christmas dates.

questions.question: Failing to pay the Congestion Charge results in:
questions.explanation: Non-payment leads to a Penalty Charge Notice (PCN).

questions.question: Licensed London taxis are:
questions.explanation: Hackney carriages licensed by TfL are exempt.

questions.question: Most private hire vehicles in London are:
options: Liable to pay the Congestion Charge unless they meet a specific exemption
questions.explanation: Most PHVs must pay; only specific exemptions apply.

questions.question: The Congestion Charge zone is broadly:
Payment for the Congestion Charge can be made via:
questions.explanation: TfL provides Auto Pay, online and app payment options.

questions.question: Auto Pay charges your vehicle:
options: Automatically on days you drive in the zone
questions.explanation: Auto Pay records entries and bills monthly.

questions.question: Driving in the zone with false plates to avoid the charge is:
questions.explanation: Plate cloning is a serious criminal offence.
